generator: scripts/invariants.mjs — the page's own invariant finder (HCC_INVARIANTS.find) run on every laboratory, across its declared domain and along its clock where it has one

method.samples: up to 48 per question, deterministic seed, eight-second cap per question
method.exact: relative spread below 1e-9 at every sample
method.named: closed forms to 1e-10 (rational × π^k, roots, φ, √5, one CODATA constant); nothing is named that is not numerically that value; values are recorded to 15 digits so the page can name them to the same standard
method.guard: a relation among k features needs k+3 distinct points; a laboratory's own residuals are reported by size, never searched
